## 2024-05-22 - [O(1) RegEx Capturing Match Loop]
**Learning:** When using `String.prototype.split` with a single capturing regular expression to highlight words in text, the resulting array is guaranteed to alternate between non-matching text (even indices) and the captured matching text (odd indices).
**Action:** Next time you need to iterate through tokens generated by a capturing split to identify which are the original target matches, do not use an $O(N)$ array lookup or `.some` check. Instead, rely on an $O(1)$ index check like `index % 2 === 1`.
